correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the Markov chain by symmetry: B_k leaves at rate k for A_{k-1}; A_k leaf and hub collision branches give the stated first-step equation, eliminating the B_{k+1} term and yielding the parity-decoupled two-step recurrence. Harmonic telescoping proves every state and boundary case; harmonic asymptotics give fixed, sublinear and linear hub mobility regimes with correct total hub rate normalization. A standalone full labeled-generator independent checker verified 4,840 exact rational residual identities, 210 exact rational linear solutions, and 18 finite asymptotic comparisons. These are corroborative, not a proof beyond finite sizes.

value.rationale: Annihilation completion time under location-dependent kinetic heterogeneity is a natural interacting-particle observable. The exact all-initial-state classification exhibits rate-dependent odd/even asymptotic constants and a meaningful hub-rate crossover: ν of logarithmic order first changes the leading logarithmic scale, while ν proportional to leaf count yields parity-distinct linear limiting times. Contrasts with published equal-rate discrete-step star models; provides testable structural understanding beyond a small numerical gain.
